name: webex-cx-ai-github-reader
description: Answers questions using current content from the ciscoAISCG/webex-cx-ai GitHub repository.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about the AI SCG GitHub repository
interface.longDescription: Finds and explains current content in ciscoAISCG/webex-cx-ai, including Cookbooks, Skills, Plugins, Playbooks, repository guidance, and GitHub discussions. Uses public repository content without requiring a GitHub token when internet-enabled tools are available.
capabilities: Search and read public repository files
Answer questions about Cookbooks, Skills, Plugins, and Playbooks
Cite source paths and GitHub links
Summarize issues and pull requests when GitHub tools are connected
defaultPrompt: Find the playbooks in the AI SCG repository related to appointment scheduling.
Answer this question using the current Cookbooks and cite the source files.
Find the AI SCG plugin or skill that can help with this task.
